eliminatedThisRound.descr: Let’s Talk About Shiba Inu August 2020 marked a turning point in the world of cryptocurrencies. In this post, we’ll dive into the beginnings of one of the most influential and talked-about coins in recent years: SHIBA INU. At that time, Uniswap, the groundbreaking DeFi platform, was already enabling the creation of liquidity pools on Ethereum, paving the way for projects like Shiba Inu. It was during this pivotal moment that SHIBA INU emerged, quickly gaining unexpected popularity. Coincidentally, my company, ECS TEAM LTD, was also founded in August 2020, making that month a significant milestone both for Shiba Inu and my journey into the crypto space. The media has often highlighted this critical launch of Shiba Inu, and as you can see from the attached screenshot, it’s a moment forever etched in the history of the cryptocurrency world. This post serves as a warm welcome to what will be an exciting conversation about cryptocurrencies, starting with Bitcoin, which first sparked my curiosity back in 2012, as I began envisioning the future of decentralized finance. Later, we’ll discuss the mysterious term **Ryoshi*, often linked to the heart and soul of Shiba Inu. But that story is for another day…
